text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Eligible risks are those whose occurrence is not foreseeable and which are beyond the control of the operator.", "gist": "Eligible risks are unforeseeable and beyond the operator's control."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "In the case of thermal networks, the restriction or loss of heat production and the loss of a significant portion of heat sales are considered such risks.", "gist": "For thermal networks, restricted heat production or significant heat sales loss are eligible risks."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "For long-term thermal storage it is the reduction in storage efficiency of more than 15% and, in the case of pit thermal energy storage, the unforeseeable restriction of surface use (so-called dual use).", "gist": "For long-term thermal storage, eligible risks include >15% efficiency loss or unforeseeable surface use restriction for pit storage."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The cover is for up to CHF 5 million and covers a maximum of half of the sustained financial loss.", "gist": "Coverage is up to CHF 5 million, covering at most 50% of sustained financial loss."}, {"type": "other", "quote": "itinero@bfe.admin.ch", "gist": "Contact email address for itinero at BFE.admin.ch"}]}
